/* ===== CSS Variables — 米白 #FCF9E8 + 星光蓝 #41BBC8 浅色主题 ===== */
:root {
  --bg-deep: #FCF9E8;
  --bg-base: #F5F1E0;
  --bg-card: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
  --bg-card-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
  --border-glass: rgba(65, 187, 200, 0.2);
  --border-glow: rgba(65, 187, 200, 0.45);
  --text-primary: #1a2e35;

  --accent-cyan: #41BBC8;
  --accent-purple: #2a9daf;
  --accent-blue: #5ec9d6;
  --success: #16a34a;
  --warning: #d97706;
  --danger: #dc2626;
  --archived: #6b7280;
  --merged: #7c3aed;
  --superseded: #d97706;
  --radius-lg: 20px;
  --radius-md: 14px;
  --radius-sm: 8px;
  --sidebar-w: 260px;
  /* ★ P2-perf：字体本地化 —— 系统字体回落栈（Windows 微软雅黑 / macOS 苹方） */
  --font-display: 'Space Grotesk', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Segoe UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-body: 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', 'Space Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;
}

/* ===== Dark Theme ===== */
[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg-deep: #0a0f14;
  --bg-base: #0f1620;
  --bg-card: rgba(20, 30, 42, 0.85);
  --bg-card-hover: rgba(28, 40, 56, 0.95);
  --border-glass: rgba(65, 187, 200, 0.15);
  --border-glow: rgba(65, 187, 200, 0.4);
  --text-primary: #e2e8f0;
  --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
  --text-muted: #64748b;
  --accent-cyan: #22d3ee;
  --accent-purple: #a78bfa;
  --accent-blue: #38bdf8;
  --success: #34d399;
  --warning: #fbbf24;
  --danger: #f87171;
  --archived: #64748b;
  --merged: #c084fc;
  --superseded: #fbbf24;
}
[data-theme="dark"] body {
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, #0a0f14 0%, #0f1620 45%, #0c1420 100%);
}
[data-theme="dark"] .glass-card { background: rgba(20, 30, 42, 0.85); }
[data-theme="dark"] .modal { background: rgba(15, 22, 32, 0.98); }
[data-theme="dark"] .form-field textarea,

[data-theme="dark"] .data-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.02); }
[data-theme="dark"] .global-loading { background: rgba(10,15,20,0.85); }
[data-theme="dark"] .topbar { background: rgba(15, 22, 32, 0.85); border-bottom-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
[data-theme="dark"] .nav-item { color: rgba(226,232,240,0.7); }

[data-theme="dark"] .nav-group-title { color: rgba(226,232,240,0.4); }
[data-theme="dark"] .logo-title { color: #e2e8f0; }
[data-theme="dark"] .logo-sub { color: rgba(226,232,240,0.5); }
[data-theme="dark"] .page-title { color: #e2e8f0; }
[data-theme="dark"] .card-title { color: #e2e8f0; }
[data-theme="dark"] .data-table th { color: rgba(226,232,240,0.6); border-bottom-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
[data-theme="dark"] .data-table td { color: rgba(226,232,240,0.85); border-bottom-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
[data-theme="dark"] .data-table tbody tr:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }
[data-theme="dark"] .filter-btn { color: rgba(226,232,240,0.6); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); }
[data-theme="dark"] .filter-btn:hover { color: #e2e8f0; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); }
